content: “Deg wass nni ggur ad tedduqqez ict n tařa i taddart n Dawud uřa i imezdaɣ n Urcalim, ḍidd i ddenb u ḍidd i řexmej.
Deg wass nni ad imsar, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, Necc ad teḥḥiɣ ismawen n řexyařat n l’aṣnam zi temmurt, ḥima war xasen ɛeqqřen ɛad. Uřa d inabiyyen d buḥbeř amengus ad ten ssuffɣeɣ zi temmurt.

Ad imsar, mařa ca n ijjen ad inebba, belli babas d yemmas inni t-i-dd ijjin, ad as inin: ‘Cek war ttɣimid teddared, maɣar cek tessiwřed ixarriqen deg isem n SIDI!’ Babas d yemmas inni t-i-dd ijjin, ad t ssnuqqben xmi ɣa inebba.
Deg wass nni ad imsar aqa inabiyyen ad seḍḥan, kuř ijj x řewḥiy nnes i itwařa xmi tuɣa inebba. Nitni war ttiriḍen ca apartessu n ccɛar n inabiyyen maḥend ad ssxarrqen.
Netta ad yini ‘Necc war ǧiɣ d anabi, necc d ijj n weryaz wenni ittfeǧḥen iyyar, minzi ikseb ayi ijjen zi temẓi inu.’
Ad as inin: ‘Min ɛnan xenni iyezzimen-a deg ifassen nnec?’, ad yini netta: ‘Ammu i wtin ayi di taddart n imɛizzen inu.’”
“Ssif, kkar x Umeksaw inu u x weryaz nni iǧan d amɛacar inu!, ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat. Wwet Ameksaw inu uca xenni ad immsebḍa wuǧi, maca Necc ad arreɣ afus inu ɛawed i useřqi tiwwa imuqřiřen.”
“Ad imsar di tammurt marra, iqqar SIDI, aqa tnayen n izeynat ad ttwaqeḍɛen u nitni ad ssuffɣen buḥbeř, maca azyen wiss třata ad dayes iqqim.

Azyen wiss třata ad t nḍareɣ di tmessi, uca Necc ad ten ssᵉṣfiɣ am mammec sseṣfan nnuqart u Necc ad ten jarrbeɣ am mammec ttjarraben ureɣ. Nitni ad řaɣan s Yisem inu u Necc ad asen sřeɣ. Ad iniɣ: ‘Řgens inu!’ u nitni ad inin: ‘SIDI d AREBBI inu!’”
